lines.text: Paul says the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives, and uses a married woman as an example.
Believers died to the law through the body of Christ, so they might belong to Moses and bear fruit to God.

wrong_details.true: Him who was raised from the dead

lines.text: Believers have been released from the law, so they serve in the new way of the Spirit.
Paul says the law is not sin, but he would not have known stealing was wrong if the law had not said so.
Paul says sin deceived him through the commandment, and the law is holy, righteous, and good.
